text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — SEV2 — edge TLS handshake failures spike for api.redwood.com. 5xx rate rising to ~18% over 3m, error string: "tls: handshake failure (sni mismatch)". Auto-escalation in 5m. https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 auto-page fired to #incidents, on-call: @ryan_c.

ryan_c: ack — I'm on it. pinging infra and cert team. ETA 5m to gather data.

maria_g: seeing lots of ALB backend logs with TLS alert code 40 (handshake failure). Snapshot: 
```
2026-02-14T02:18:41Z lb=alb-us-east-1 target=10.2.5.12:443 "tls: handshake failure (sni mismatch)" path=/v1/generate
2026-02-14T02:18:42Z lb=alb-eu-west-1 target=10.3.8.9:443 "tls: handshake failure" path=/v1/chat
```

sam_t: no DNS changes in last 24h from infra side. Route53 logs look normal.

alex_k: certification rollout last night at 02:14 UTC — we rolled intermediate cert to edge CDN. tagging @maria_g since she owns cert rollout.

maria_g: yep I triggered a canary for the new cert. Canary passed initially but looks like some clients (alb targets) are rejecting SNI or cert chain differs. pulling certs now.

infra-bot: ALB target group tg-edge-prod showing healthy_count drop: 120 -> 86 over 3m in eu-west-1.

ryan_c: customer impact: 12-18% of requests for /v1/* are 5xx, error concentrated in EU region. No major customers reported yet but some API keys show surge in errors. Logging a customer-impact note for ops.

jess_oncall: looping in @alex_k and @maria_g — if it's cert chain mismatch we can roll back to previous cert in CDN and force revalidation of targets. That will be a short traffic flap but should restore service.

maria_g: prepared rollback artifact: `edge-cert-2026-02-13.pem`. Command to rollback (edge-admin):
```bash
edge-admin cert replace --service edge-cdn --cert edge-cert-2026-02-13.pem --env prod --force
```
I'll stage this in 3m after we confirm fallback behavior on a single region.

sam_t: suggestion: route eu-west traffic to healthy target group tg-edge-fallback while rollback occurs. That avoids global flap. I can flip ALB routing weight for 60s.

ryan_c: do it. @sam_t perform weight shift and @maria_g prepare rollback. Notify when done.

sam_t: shifting 80% traffic -> tg-edge-fallback in eu-west-1 now. monitoring.

infra-bot: weight shift complete. Observed immediate drop in 5xx from 18% -> 4% in 30s.

ryan_c: good. please proceed with CDN cert rollback. coordinate with deploy-bot.

maria_g: initiating rollback in 30s. will monitor handshake logs.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by maria_g: edge-cert rollback to edge-cert-2026-02-13.pem. JobID=jb-77821.

maria_g: rollback finished. confirming logs...

maria_g: logs show handshake failures almost gone. ALB healthy_count recovering to 118. EU 5xx down to 2.1%.

ryan_c: great. mitigation successful. keeping incident open for verification and RCA. Root cause preliminary: cert canary introduced a cert chain that some ALB targets did not accept — likely ordering or missing intermediate. Need joint postmortem: cert rollout verifier, ALB client compatibility, and safer canary gating.

alex_k: filing follow-up runbook item to test canary across all target types (ALB, direct backends) before full rollout.

jess_oncall: handing off to @maria_g for RCA/PM notes. I will stay on standby for 30m then close if no regression.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by ryan_c, status: Mitigated, awaiting postmortem.

incident-bot: Note: create postmortem ticket and link logs + pagerduty timeline. Templates: /ops/incidents/postmortem-template.
